input.name: images
notes: Square input only. Export rejects a non-square imgsz, and height equals width, 640 by default.
LibreRTDETR also exports at other square sizes, such as 512. LibreRTDETRv2 exports at 640 only: any other imgsz fails during export with a tensor size mismatch.
Stretch the whole image to width x height with cv2.resize and INTER_LINEAR on the 8-bit RGB image. There is no letterbox and no padding, so the aspect ratio is not kept.
Then divide by 255. There is no mean or std normalization.

outputs.name: pred_logits
outputs.meaning: Raw class logits per query, sigmoid not applied. 300 queries and 80 classes for the COCO checkpoints.

outputs.name: pred_boxes
outputs.meaning: Boxes as cx, cy, w, h, normalized 0 to 1 of the input.

postprocess: Apply sigmoid to pred_logits.

Flatten the scores to queries x nc and take the top max_det (300 by default) over all queries x classes. For flat index k, the query is k // nc and the class is k % nc. One query can yield several classes.
Keep the entries whose score is strictly above the confidence threshold (0.25 by default). There is no NMS, so the IoU threshold is not used.
Convert the query's box to x1, y1, x2, y2 with x1 = cx - w / 2, y1 = cy - h / 2, x2 = cx + w / 2, y2 = cy + h / 2.
Map boxes back to the original image: multiply x by the original width and y by the original height. The input was stretched, so no pad offset applies. LibreYOLO does not clip these boxes.
nms=True is not available for this family: export raises NotImplementedError.

input.name: images
notes: Square input only, 1024 x 1024. Export rejects a non-square imgsz, and any other square size fails during export with a tensor size mismatch.

Scale by r = min(height / h, width / w) and resize to (round(w * r), round(h * r)). This rounds to the nearest integer instead of truncating. An exact half goes to the even integer, as Python round does.
Paste the resized image in the top-left corner of a canvas filled with 0. The padding is on the right and bottom only.
On the test image, cv2.resize with INTER_LINEAR or INTER_AREA changes the detection count and moves boxes by more than 2 px.

Pillow computes each pass in fixed point: it rounds every weight to an integer with 22 fractional bits (round half away from zero), sums weight x pixel in integers, adds 2^21, shifts right by 22 and clips to 0 to 255.
Use that integer arithmetic for this model. Float weights differ from Pillow by a level on a few pixels, and on the test image that turns one box by 0.2 rad.
Divide the whole canvas by 255 after the resize. There is no mean or std normalization.

outputs.name: pred_logits
outputs.meaning: Raw class logits per query, sigmoid not applied. 300 queries and 15 DOTA classes for the released checkpoints.

outputs.name: pred_boxes
outputs.meaning: Rotated boxes as cx, cy, w, h, a. cx and w are normalized 0 to 1 of the input width, cy and h of the input height, both on the padded canvas. a is the angle divided by pi, 0 to 1.

postprocess: Apply sigmoid to pred_logits.

Flatten the scores to queries x nc and take the top max_det (300 by default) over all queries x classes. For flat index k, the query is k // nc and the class is k % nc. One query can yield several classes.
Keep the entries whose score is strictly above the confidence threshold (0.25 by default). There is no NMS, rotated or axis-aligned, so the IoU threshold is not used.

Map boxes back to the original image: multiply cx and w by the input width, cy and h by the input height, then divide all four by r. The padding is on the right and bottom, so no offset applies. LibreYOLO does not clip these boxes.
The angle in radians is a x pi. LibreYOLO reports each box as cx, cy, w, h, angle in original-image pixels and radians.

The corners are (cx + dx cos(angle) - dy sin(angle), cy + dx sin(angle) + dy cos(angle)) for (dx, dy) = (-w / 2, -h / 2), (w / 2, -h / 2), (w / 2, h / 2), (-w / 2, h / 2). With y pointing down, a positive angle turns the box clockwise on screen.
LibreYOLO's axis-aligned box for a detection is the smallest box that encloses its four corners.
nms=True is not available for this family: export raises NotImplementedError.
